_note: The portfolio, in display order. build.py writes it into the home and work pages; package.py stages each entry's sources at coveworks.tech/work/<slug>/. 'sources' are [path in the repository, path inside the slug]. 'extra' is staged the same way but not listed.

work.title: Vassallo Developments
work.text: A brand site for Vassallo Developments, who acquire, redesign and rebuild homes worth living in. It opens on a renovation film that walks into a derelict house and back out as every room rebuilds itself around the camera, and carries a 3D door and window configurator for their trade customers.

work.title: Dar Ul Amir
work.text: The storefront of darulamir.com, House of the Prince: a thobe atelier and perfumery based in the United Kingdom, shipping worldwide. Four Emirati thobes in sizes 52 to 62 and fourteen perfumes with live pricing, beneath a scroll driven palace intro and a sky of gold dust.

work.title: Ivory Room Aesthetics
work.tag: Clinic and academy · Twenty four pages
work.text: A clinic and training academy in one: twenty four pages covering six treatments, twelve training courses, the team, a become a model programme and booking, in an ivory, ink and champagne system set in Marcellus and Jost.

work.title: Fenwick & Rowe
work.text: Three complete editions for a London accountancy firm: a twelve page standard site, a dark premium edition with a fee calculator and deadline countdown, and a calm typographic Ledger edition with a deadline finder.

work.title: Lowtide 1996
work.text: A twelve page storefront for a London streetwear label: drops, the cut, lookbook, archive and a page for every piece, built on a two skin design system where each plate can be inverted to reveal its second colourway.

work.title: Halcyon Drive
work.text: A private collection of performance cars for self drive hire in London, prepared to a standard and handed over anywhere in the city. WhatsApp booking, a live fleet ticker and a night blue and gold identity.

work.title: Driveway Mechanic
work.text: A site for a mobile mechanic who comes to your driveway across East London and Essex. Delivered as two complete designs to choose from, each a single self contained file.
